introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: This Privacy Policy explains how X Dental Store collects, uses, stores, protects, and shares information when you visit our website, create an account, browse products, request quotes, place orders, use supply lists, or contact support.

informationCollected.title: Information We Collect
informationCollected.paragraph1: Account information may include your full name, email address, phone number, account preferences, selected clinic specialty or major, and authentication information needed to create and manage your account. Passwords and authentication data should be processed securely and stored using hashed or encrypted methods according to security best practices; X Dental Store should not store plain-text passwords.
informationCollected.paragraph2: Clinic and order information may include clinic name, delivery address, billing details where collected, order history, quote requests, product requests, supply lists, wishlist and cart activity, and preferred brands, categories, or products.
informationCollected.paragraph3: Payment information may include payment method status, transaction references, and payment confirmation status. X Dental Store does not need to store full card numbers when sensitive payment details are processed by a third-party payment provider, and those providers may handle payment data under their own policies.
informationCollected.paragraph4: Communication information may include messages sent through contact forms, support requests, WhatsApp messages, call or email records, feedback, reviews, uploaded content, or other information you choose to send to us.
informationCollected.paragraph5: Technical and usage information may include IP address, browser and device type, pages visited, search queries, product or category interactions, cookies, local storage, error logs, and approximate location information from your browser, device, or network where available.

informationUse.title: How We Use Information
informationUse.paragraph1: X Dental Store uses information to create and manage user accounts, process orders and quote requests, manage supply lists, carts, wishlists, repeat purchases, product requests, delivery coordination, and customer support.
informationUse.paragraph2: We may also use information to personalize product recommendations, including Clinic Essentials based on clinic specialty, communicate about orders, delivery, support, offers, and account updates, improve website performance and user experience, prevent fraud or misuse, protect security, and meet legal, accounting, tax, or operational obligations.

specialtyPersonalization.title: Clinic Specialty Personalization
specialtyPersonalization.paragraph1: X Dental Store may use the clinic specialty selected during signup or saved in your profile to personalize product recommendations and make clinic purchasing tools more relevant.
specialtyPersonalization.paragraph2: This may affect areas such as Clinic Essentials, recommended products, reorder suggestions, category highlights, or other product discovery features. If your specialty changes, you may be able to update it through your account tools or contact support for help, depending on the features currently available.

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.paragraph1: The website may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to keep users signed in, remember preferences, manage cart and wishlist activity, support security, improve performance, and understand how the website is used.
cookies.paragraph2: You can control cookies through your browser settings. If you block or delete cookies, some website features may not work as expected, including account sessions, saved preferences, cart behavior, and certain personalization features.

informationSharing.title: How We Share Information
informationSharing.paragraph1: X Dental Store may share information with suppliers, distributors, couriers, logistics providers, payment providers, hosting, database, email, SMS, WhatsApp, support, analytics, performance, security, legal, accounting, or business service providers where needed to operate the website and fulfill customer requests.
informationSharing.paragraph2: Information may also be shared with legal or regulatory authorities where required by law, or with professional advisors where needed for accounting, legal, tax, compliance, or business purposes.
informationSharing.paragraph3: X Dental Store does not sell users' personal information to advertisers.

browseProducts.description: Browse dental supplies by category, brand, specialty, or search. You can explore clinic essentials, instruments, consumables, equipment, and trusted dental brands.

productDetails.title: Open Product Details
productDetails.description: Open any product to review its details, images, brand, price if available, and availability status before adding it to your order.

cartOrQuote.description: For standard products, you can add items directly to your cart. For bulk quantities, machines, special products, or items that need confirmation, you can request a quote before ordering.

account.title: Create or Sign In to Your Account
account.description: Creating an account helps you manage orders, quotes, supply lists, saved products, clinic information, and repeat purchases.

deliveryDetails.description: Add your delivery address, phone number, and any important delivery notes. Please make sure your contact details are correct so the X Dental Store delivery team can reach you.

shippingDeliveryPage.description: Learn how X Dental Store delivers dental supplies, fast delivery products, and special clinic orders.

fastProducts.title: Fast Delivery Products
fastProducts.description: Selected products are eligible for same-day or next-day delivery when available in stock and within supported coverage.
fastProducts.emptyTitle: Fast Delivery products will appear here soon.
fastProducts.emptyDescription: Products shown here come from the catalog when they are marked as Fast Delivery.
fastProducts.cardDescription: Eligible for same-day or next-day delivery depending on stock and location.

confirmOrder.title: Confirm your order
confirmOrder.description: We verify key details such as availability, address, phone number, and payment method when needed.

prepareDispatch.title: Prepare and dispatch
prepareDispatch.description: Eligible products are packed and handed to the X Dental Store delivery team according to product handling needs.

receiveDelivery.title: Receive your delivery
receiveDelivery.description: Please check the shipment when it arrives and contact support quickly if anything needs review.

coverage.title: Delivery Coverage
coverage.paragraph1: X Dental Store provides delivery across supported locations in Egypt through its internal delivery team. Availability, cost, and timing may vary depending on your city, governorate, product type, order size, and stock availability.
coverage.paragraph2: Some products may require delivery confirmation before shipment, especially when the order includes special handling, high-value items, or products with limited stock.

confirmation.title: Order Confirmation
confirmation.paragraph1: Orders are prepared for delivery after they are confirmed. In some cases, our team may contact you to verify product availability, address details, phone number, payment method, or special delivery requirements.
confirmation.paragraph2: Confirmation helps reduce delivery errors and makes sure the correct products are prepared for your clinic order.

standard.title: Standard Delivery
standard.paragraph1: Standard delivery usually takes 2-5 business days depending on location, X Dental Store delivery coverage, product availability, and order confirmation time.
standard.paragraph2: Delivery to remote areas or during busy periods may take longer.

fastDelivery.title: Fast Delivery Products
fastDelivery.paragraph1: Products marked as Fast Delivery are prioritized for same-day or next-day delivery, depending on stock availability, order confirmation time, and delivery location.
fastDelivery.paragraph2: Fast Delivery applies only to selected products and supported areas. It is not guaranteed for unsupported areas or unconfirmed orders.
fastDelivery.bullet1: Product is marked as Fast Delivery.
fastDelivery.bullet3: Order is confirmed before the daily cut-off time.
fastDelivery.bullet4: Delivery address is within supported fast-delivery coverage.
fastDelivery.bullet5: Payment or order confirmation is completed.

fees.title: Shipping Fees
fees.paragraph1: Delivery fees may vary depending on destination, product weight and size, COD collection, urgent delivery, or special handling.
fees.paragraph2: For standard products, the delivery fee may appear during checkout. For special products, our team may confirm the shipping cost before dispatch.

cashOnDelivery.title: Cash on Delivery
cashOnDelivery.paragraph1: Cash on Delivery may be available for selected orders and locations.
cashOnDelivery.paragraph2: X Dental Store may limit COD for high-value products, special orders, large equipment, or products requiring special handling. Prepayment or additional confirmation may be requested for certain orders.

specialProducts.title: Special Products and Shipping Quote
specialProducts.paragraph1: Some dental products require special handling and cannot always be delivered through the standard X Dental Store delivery process.
specialProducts.paragraph2: Large machines, heavy equipment, fragile instruments, liquids, gels, disinfectants, chemicals, adhesives, high-value instruments, and restricted dental materials may require a shipping quote before dispatch.

failedDelivery.title: Failed Delivery and Rescheduling
failedDelivery.paragraph1: If the X Dental Store delivery team cannot reach you, or if the address details are incorrect, delivery may be delayed, rescheduled, or returned.
failedDelivery.paragraph2: Additional delivery fees may apply for repeated delivery attempts or returned orders after the team confirms the details with you.

orderIssues.title: Damaged, Missing, or Wrong Items
orderIssues.paragraph1: Please check your order when it arrives.
orderIssues.paragraph2: If an item is damaged, missing, or different from your order, contact our support team as soon as possible with your order number and clear photos. Please keep the original packaging until the issue is reviewed.

delays.title: Delivery Delays
delays.paragraph1: Delivery may be delayed due to team capacity, public holidays, weather, remote locations, wrong address details, unavailable customer, product availability, or events outside our control.

updates.title: Policy Updates
updates.paragraph1: X Dental Store may update this Shipping & Delivery Policy from time to time as delivery coverage, fees, and operational rules change.

sidebar.title: Need confirmation?
sidebar.description: Contact support before ordering large machines, liquids, chemicals, fragile items, or urgent clinic supplies.

contactSupport.title: Contact Support
contactSupport.description: Send your order number, product details, and reason for the return or exchange request.

reviewEligibility.title: Review Eligibility
reviewEligibility.description: Our team checks product condition, supplier rules, courier notes, and applicable return requirements.

confirmResolution.title: Confirm Return or Resolution
confirmResolution.description: If approved, support confirms the next step, replacement option, refund method, or alternative solution.

requests.title: Return Requests
requests.paragraph1: To request a return or exchange, please contact X Dental Store support with your order number, product details, and the reason for the request. Our team will review the request and confirm the next steps.

period.title: Return Period
period.paragraph1: Return requests must be submitted within the approved return period confirmed by X Dental Store. The final return window may vary depending on product type, supplier policy, and applicable rules.

conditions.title: Return Conditions
conditions.paragraph1: Returned products should usually be unused, unopened, in their original packaging, and complete with all accessories, labels, manuals, or included items.
conditions.paragraph2: Products damaged by misuse, improper storage, or customer handling may not be eligible for return.

nonReturnable.title: Non-Returnable Products
nonReturnable.paragraph1: For safety and hygiene reasons, some dental products may not be eligible for return once opened, unsealed, used, installed, or specially ordered.
nonReturnable.bullet2: Sterile products once opened or unsealed
nonReturnable.bullet3: Liquids, gels, disinfectants, chemicals, and adhesives
nonReturnable.bullet6: Machines or equipment after installation or use
nonReturnable.bullet8: Expired products after customer receipt if not reported immediately

orderIssues.title: Damaged, Missing, or Wrong Items
orderIssues.paragraph1: If your order arrives damaged, missing an item, or different from what you ordered, please contact support as soon as possible. Include your order number, clear photos of the product and packaging, and a short description of the issue.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.paragraph1: Refund approval, method, and timing depend on the product condition, supplier review, and the details of the order.
refunds.paragraph2: Approved refunds are handled directly by the X Dental Store team. The team will contact you to confirm the available refund arrangement.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.paragraph1: Exchanges may be available for eligible products if the requested replacement is in stock. If the replacement product is unavailable, the team may suggest an alternative solution.

shippingFees.title: Return Shipping Fees
shippingFees.paragraph1: Return shipping fees may depend on the reason for the return.
shippingFees.paragraph2: If the return is due to a wrong, missing, or damaged item caused by X Dental Store, supplier, or delivery handling, the case will be reviewed by support. If the return is due to customer preference or incorrect customer information, return delivery fees may apply.

specialOrders.title: Special Orders and Machines
specialOrders.paragraph1: Special-order products, machines, large equipment, installed items, and quote-based orders may have separate cancellation, exchange, and return rules.
specialOrders.paragraph2: These items may require review and approval before any return or refund is accepted.

updates.title: Policy Updates
updates.paragraph1: X Dental Store may update this Returns Policy from time to time as supplier rules, delivery policies, product categories, and business operations change.

sidebar.title: Before you return
sidebar.description: Return windows and category-specific restrictions can vary by product type. Our support team will confirm the exact steps for your order.

information.paragraph1: To help us check your order faster, please prepare your order number, contact details, and any confirmation message you received from X Dental Store.

statuses.title: Tracking Statuses
statuses.paragraph1: Order statuses in your account are shown in simple stages so you can understand where your order is in the review process.

courier.paragraph1: If courier tracking is available for your order, the tracking number or courier update may appear in your account or be shared by the support team.

quoteBeforeOrdering.question: Can I request a quote before ordering?
quoteBeforeOrdering.answer: Yes. You can request a quote before placing an order, especially for bulk quantities, clinic purchases, or products that need price confirmation.

trackQuotes.question: Where can I track my quote requests?
trackQuotes.answer: You can track your quote requests from your account under the Quotes section.

orderVsQuote.question: What is the difference between placing an order and requesting a quote?
orderVsQuote.answer: Placing an order is used when you are ready to buy with the listed product details. Requesting a quote is useful when you need pricing confirmation, bulk pricing, or special product availability review.

supplyLists.title: Supply Lists
supplyLists.description: Learn how saved lists can make repeated clinic purchasing faster.

saveRepeatedLists.question: Can clinics save monthly or repeated purchase lists?
saveRepeatedLists.answer: Yes. Clinics can create Supply Lists to save frequently purchased products and reorder them faster in the future.

whatIsSupplyList.question: What is a Supply List?
whatIsSupplyList.answer: A Supply List is a saved list of products that a clinic may need regularly, such as monthly essentials or repeated clinic supplies.

cartToSupplyList.question: Can I add products from my cart to a Supply List?
cartToSupplyList.answer: Yes. You can save cart items as a reusable Supply List for faster future ordering.

productRequests.title: Product Requests
productRequests.description: See how to request an unlisted product and track the request in your account.

unlistedProduct.question: Can I request a product that is not listed on the website?
unlistedProduct.answer: Yes. If a product is not listed, you can send a product request with the product name, brand, or details so the team can review it.

unavailableProduct.question: What happens if a product is unavailable?
unavailableProduct.answer: You can submit a product request. The request will be sent to the company for review, and the team can later reply with availability or alternatives.

requestsInAccount.question: Will product requests appear in my account?
requestsInAccount.answer: Yes. Product requests should appear in your account as sent requests so you can track them. Full email/chat handling will be connected during the backend phase.
